{{Quote|Platt Okeefe was wondering if spacers out the Lan Barell way might drop in on the Chyakk clan (the Wookiees, not the Bentora Space people) at the Shullel spaceport and tell them she's found the parts they wanted already.|A news report by Cynabar's InfoNet|<ref name="GNN">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>}}
'''Bentora Space''' was a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="GNN" /> It shared its name with the [[Bentora system/Legends|Bentora system]], which was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Samix sector/Legends|Samix sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Bentora Space was home to a group known as the [[Chyakk clan (Bentora Space)|Chyakk clan]]. On the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[0 ABY/Legends|36:1:16]], a news report by [[Cynabar's InfoNet/Legends|Cynabar's InfoNet]] mentioned that<ref name="GNN" /> the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]<ref name="CSWE Okeefe">{{CSWECite|II|406|Okeefe, Platt}}</ref> [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]] wished to relay a message to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chyakk clan/Legends|Chyakk clan]] on<ref name="GNN" /> the [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]]<ref name="EAOC Lan">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Lan system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Lan Barell">{{CSWECite|II|243|Lan Barell}}</ref> [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]]. To disambiguate, the news report distinguished between the Chyakk clan of Lan Barell and that of Bentora Space.<ref name="GNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bentora Space was introduced by [[Paul Sudlow]] in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 5]], which was published in [[February]] [[1995]].<ref name="GNN" />
